class.name: NNConsideration
class.brief_description: Scores a behaviour, branch, or state from a sensor or numeric input and an optional curve.
class.description: Add as a child of an [NNBehaviour], [NNBehaviourGroup], [NNConsiderationGroup], or utility-scored behaviour tree or state tree node to contribute a [code]0..1[/code] score during evaluation. Assign an [member input_sensor] (or update [member activation_input_value] from script) and optionally shape the result with [member activation_curve] (using either a [Curve] or an [NNResponseCurve]). For custom scoring logic, override [method on_evaluate] in a script. Set [member NNConsiderations.has_vetoed] to [code]true[/code] to immediately disqualify the parent option with a score of [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: on_evaluate
method.description: Override to compute a custom score (typically in [code]0..1[/code]) instead of using [member activation_curve]. Call [method sample_activation_curve] if you still want to shape a value with the curve.

method.name: sample_activation_curve
method.description: Evaluates [member activation_curve] at [param input_value], or returns [code]0.0[/code] if no curve is assigned.

members.member: Optional [Curve] or [NNResponseCurve] that maps [member activation_input_value] to [member NNConsiderations.score]. If unset, [member activation_input_value] is used directly.
Input value (typically [code]0..1[/code]) passed to [member activation_curve] or used directly as the score. Overwritten automatically by [member input_sensor] when one is assigned.
Optional sensor or sensor group whose [member NNSensors.sensor_value] feeds [member activation_input_value] on each evaluation.
